# Aditya Kulkarni

> Personal portfolio of Aditya Kulkarni, a first-year Computer Science and AI student at Scaler School of Technology (SST) - builder, runner, and competitive programmer.

## Sections

- [Home](https://adityakulkarni-eta.vercel.app/): overview of his work and focus
- [Projects](https://adityakulkarni-eta.vercel.app/projects): sixteen projects - two deep dives (his portfolio workflow and Setu, a junior-senior doubt platform) and fourteen live sites, including journals, a cricket scorer, a code reviewer and a time machine
- [Academics](https://adityakulkarni-eta.vercel.app/academics): entrance exams (JEE Main 97.4 percentile, MHT-CET 98.4 percentile, JEE Advanced AIR 21,300), schools from EuroKids to SST, olympiads, and current studies
- [Beyond The Terminal](https://adityakulkarni-eta.vercel.app/beyond): seven years of Himalayan trekking with GGIM Pune, daily running, sport, and music
- [Community](https://adityakulkarni-eta.vercel.app/community): leadership roles, clubs, events and volunteering at SST, plus contact details

## Code

- [GitHub](https://github.com/Aditya2375): source for the portfolio and the projects
